newsitem.title: UK: Several people leave hijacked plane - witnesses.
newsitem.headline: Several people leave hijacked plane - witnesses.

text.p: Several people were seen by eyewitnesses on Tuesday to leave a hijacked Sudan Airways plane carrying 199 passengers and crew that earlier landed at London's Stansted airport.
Reporters saw about 10 people come down the steps from the Airbus 310 just before 6.30 a.m, two hours after the aircraft landed from Cyprus.
The plane was hijacked on Monday evening soon after it left Khartoum for the Jordanian capital Amman.
The unidentified hijackers had told police in Cyprus they would release the passengers once they landed in London. They said they wanted to claim political asylum in Britain.
British police said the hijackers had issued just one demand -- that they be allowed to speak to an unidentified fellow countryman who is in London.
